chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali al-Halabi narrated from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
I said to him: “Who is the one whose maintenance I am compelled to provide?” He said: “The two parents, the child, the wife, and the minor heir—meaning the brother, the brother’s son, and others.”
ai.seo_question: Who is a person legally obligated to provide maintenance for in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith states who a person may be legally compelled to support financially. It identifies parents, children, wives, and certain minor heirs among those whose maintenance is obligatory, showing the emphasis of Islamic law on family responsibility and the protection of dependents.
